answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the glacier of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The opal lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the velvet is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
